entities.summary: Bruce John Kuczenski is an American former professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-10-inch (208 cm) 230 pounds (100 kg) power forward/center born in Bristol, Connecticut and played collegiately at the University of Connecticut from 1979 to 1983.
